admission.justification: The no-touch guarantee is realized jointly in the staging owner, the Git runner and the cache helper across three files, and the converted-drift suite proves it: interval-failure, dry-run, validated-tree publication and adopted-state cases pin each half.

applicability: Converted memory baseline adoptions that stage, validate and commit memory content through the owned prepare/stage/validate interval.
conditions: The worktree index is reachable for copying, or absent so the private file stages empty.
The knowledge validator is bound in the adopting process; where it is not, adoption refuses.
exclusions: Unconverted adoptions, which keep the direct stage-and-commit path.
Files outside the owned interval: only the prepared ignore line is ever given back, never caller or external content.

evidence: notes/reports/l44-code-extra7/private-index-probes.results.json SHA fe29f13bc5b7d7687bd586a871335de552bd38aa93b94ffb23025151a14f924c: 34/34 public dry+real original03 scenarios pass. Four quiet ITA and two quiet untracked-symlink former failures now preserve the entry raw index bytes, stage lines and semantic flags; executable mode-only index entries also remain exact. Partial preparation, staging, private-tree read and validation exceptions retain their named errors and restore owned ignore-file bytes/mode; copy failure refuses loudly and an absent index remains absent. Concurrent staged ignore edits, additions with assume-unchanged flags and tracked deletions stay exact. Private copies preserve source bytes/mtime and are discarded. Actual product index-addressing interval commands explicitly pin the private file; immutable object-only validation reads address tree/object IDs. A post-validation real-adoption failure retains its named OSError, publishes exactly the validated tree and occurs after real-index preservation at validation. Scoped2 pytest nodes and four-file Ruff/check-format/Pyright pass once; runner exit is distinguished from all 34 state assertions.

statement: An exception during staged-tree validation in a dry run discards the private staging index and leaves the worktree’s real index unchanged; the named error propagates after restoring only provably owned prepared ignore-file state.
